digest.component_or_area: root modules and services (src/rebar, attest, metrics, review_bot, opcert_service, audit, grounding, _guides)
propositions: Comment audit across root-level Python modules (180 lines of 7,248; 2.5%) found scope in good health with concentrated yield of corrections and rationale relocation rather than bulk removal.

Schema-drift defect in _mcp_models.py (binding_drift omission and false assurance comment) was already fixed on main; the current comment correctly cites the CI-enforced drift gate and is accurate/DO_NOT_MOVE.

Three multi-line inline rationale blocks in review_bot were relocated from code comments to new ADRs (0067: bounded shutdown; 0068: in-flight counter over-count; 0069: retryable deferral) and replaced with one-line citations, recovering lines without losing load-bearing invariants.

_config_schema.py contains ~280 comment lines that are sole documentation for keys not covered in docs/config.md; recovery beyond ~34 trivial lines requires writing docs/config.md rows first to avoid documentation loss.

_mcp_llm.py tool docstrings (~121 lines) are wire-visible MCP API surface published by FastMCP; _config_schema.py read-via markers are machine-consumed by CI gate scripts/check_config_reads.py — both remain verbatim and are DO_NOT_MOVE.

All in-scope comment units were dispositioned into one parent label (RELOCATE, DELETE, KEEP, DO_NOT_MOVE, CORRECT-IN-PLACE); merged commit 24917e843b recovered net ~224 insertions / 12 deletions with full test suite and lint passing unchanged across all matrix jobs.
